recommendations.rationale: Free users report 22 [C1] complaints about excessive ads blocking core listening. Simplifying ad placement or raising skip allowance would address the highest-volume usability blocker and may reduce upgrade friction.
recommendations.title: Reduce ad friction in free tier

recommendations.rationale: Users explicitly cite update regret (reviews 45c561b9-cc47-4d80-95d3-f0d20bc84af3, 0070e713-4cb7-4d78-954f-1764d5593c91) with high severity. Quick regression analysis or user testing of the latest redesign may surface which changes alienated users.
recommendations.title: Audit and revert recent UI/navigation changes

recommendations.rationale: Users cannot reliably pick or skip songs in playlists (9 [C3] complaints, high mean severity), undermining core music-listening intent. Verify queue sync and selection logic across device and connection states.
recommendations.title: Restore playlist and queue control

recommendations.rationale: Playback failures affect fewer users (67 [C4] severity sum) but with high intensity. Triage after usability wins to prevent further support load.
recommendations.title: Monitor playback stability as secondary focus
